demoDataNote: Fictional catalogues, prices, contacts and media are local demonstration data. Never reuse the demo database, identities or grants in a customer environment. A customer environment requires its own data, authority, policies, restricted connections and qualified provider bindings. The owned demo seed populates only catalog_products, catalog_skus, price_lists and price_entries at install with the install connection in a database explicitly marked as a demonstration. Never seed clients, stock, settings, renewal terms or method states; use their native writers.
pageCopyRequiredFor: Complete page layout or navigation changes outside the three named fragments.
New checkout, account or operator workflows or application-specific routes.
pageCopyRule: Move a copied page from managed to owned and update its imports. The adopter then owns security, accessibility, compatibility, tests and manual porting of later fixes. Package engines remain installed dependencies. For a new route, create an owned page and take ownership of client/main.ts and shared/routes.ts before updating dispatch, navigation and localized paths.
